name: keep the answer independent of a recompiled binary
definition: Produce a secret that is genuinely consistent with the recorded validation logic so it still passes even after the host recompiles the program from source.
failure_mode: A value that only works against the agent's own tampered binary fails the recompile-run.

name: keep the rest of the repository unmodified
definition: Leave all files other than the designated source untouched (byte-identical), matching the recorded hashes of the fixed files.
failure_mode: any edit to them fails the checksum test outright.

name: keep the serialized model within a tight size budget
definition: Structure the model file/directory so the entire asset is under a 100KB size ceiling.
failure_mode: Network/checkpointing/optimizer overhead pushes the directory over the limit.

name: leave the data files unmodified
definition: Perform the optimization only in the query layer so the supplied database content and structure stay byte-for-byte unchanged.
failure_mode: Temporary tables, data mutation, or index engineering that alters the file breaks the integrity check.
